import sys,time,json,M5
sys.path.append("/m5-uniform-led-39ab5c25292d490888e9b7f650bc988b")
M5.begin()
screen=M5.Display
screen.setBrightness(255)
screen.fillScreen(1325148)
screen.setTextSize(2)
screen.setTextColor(0xffffff,1325148)
screen.setCursor(12,12)
screen.print('LED i2c-hub A')
from machine import I2C, Pin
from unit import EncoderUnit, Encoder8Unit
bus=I2C(0,scl=Pin(1),sda=Pin(2),freq=100000)
scan=sorted(bus.scan())
assert scan==[0x40,0x41], 'passive HUB must expose exactly the two independent I2C addresses'
encoder=EncoderUnit(bus)
eight=Encoder8Unit(bus)
for _channel,_color in enumerate([2113632,2113632],1):
 encoder.set_color(_channel,_color)
for _channel,_color in enumerate([4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296],1):
 eight.set_led_rgb(_channel,_color)
# Original helper writes the ninth RGB triplet; no electrical-to-location claim.
eight.write_reg_data(0x88,[64,160,32])
sequence=0
while True:
 assert "/m5-uniform-led-39ab5c25292d490888e9b7f650bc988b" in sys.path, 'MicroPython VM reset'
 M5.update()
 print("UNIFORM_LED_d78e1c893903 "+json.dumps({'kind':'sample','phase':"A",'nonce':"/m5-uniform-led-39ab5c25292d490888e9b7f650bc988b",'sequence':sequence,'scan':scan,'written_colors':{"encoder":[2113632,2113632],"8encoder":[4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296,4235296]},'values':{'encoder':{'counter':encoder.get_rotary_value(),'pressed':bool(encoder.get_button_status())},'8encoder':{'counters':[eight.get_counter_value(i) for i in range(1,9)],'pressed':[bool(eight.get_button_status(i)) for i in range(1,9)],'switch-on':bool(eight.get_switch_status())}}}))
 sequence+=1
 time.sleep_ms(250)

import sys,time,json,M5
assert "/m5-uniform-led-39ab5c25292d490888e9b7f650bc988b" in sys.path, 'MicroPython VM reset'
M5.begin()
screen=M5.Display
screen.setBrightness(255)
screen.fillScreen(3548248)
screen.setTextSize(2)
screen.setTextColor(0xffffff,3548248)
screen.setCursor(12,12)
screen.print('LED i2c-hub D')
from machine import I2C, Pin
from unit import EncoderUnit, Encoder8Unit
bus=I2C(0,scl=Pin(1),sda=Pin(2),freq=100000)
scan=sorted(bus.scan())
assert scan==[0x40,0x41], 'passive HUB must expose exactly the two independent I2C addresses'
encoder=EncoderUnit(bus)
eight=Encoder8Unit(bus)
for _channel,_color in enumerate([0,0],1):
 encoder.set_color(_channel,_color)
for _channel,_color in enumerate([0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0],1):
 eight.set_led_rgb(_channel,_color)
# Original helper writes the ninth RGB triplet; no electrical-to-location claim.
eight.write_reg_data(0x88,[0,0,0])
sequence=0
while True:
 assert "/m5-uniform-led-39ab5c25292d490888e9b7f650bc988b" in sys.path, 'MicroPython VM reset'
 M5.update()
 print("UNIFORM_LED_d78e1c893903 "+json.dumps({'kind':'sample','phase':"D",'nonce':"/m5-uniform-led-39ab5c25292d490888e9b7f650bc988b",'sequence':sequence,'scan':scan,'written_colors':{"encoder":[0,0],"8encoder":[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0]},'values':{'encoder':{'counter':encoder.get_rotary_value(),'pressed':bool(encoder.get_button_status())},'8encoder':{'counters':[eight.get_counter_value(i) for i in range(1,9)],'pressed':[bool(eight.get_button_status(i)) for i in range(1,9)],'switch-on':bool(eight.get_switch_status())}}}))
 sequence+=1
 time.sleep_ms(250)

gaps: Increment clear-on-read, wraparound, reset and address-change persistence need internal firmware confirmation.
